meta.purpose: What each palette material is made of, molecule by molecule. Exists so 'these two materials go together' can be checked rather than asserted: two materials that share 40% of their mass cannot clash, and a formula's total linalool across six different naturals is a number no per-material field can show.
meta.basis: Indicative typical GC-FID area percentages, not certificates of analysis.
meta.caveat: Naturals vary by origin, harvest, distillation and age. Every percentage here is the middle of a published range, not a measurement of your drum. Treat them as proportions to reason with, not numbers to certify against.
meta.allergen_note: `eu_allergen` marks the EU Annex III declarable list. It is a labelling duty triggered by the finished product's total, summed across every source — which is exactly what a per-material field cannot see and this layer can. It is not a ban and not an IFRA limit.

constituents.name: d-Limonene
constituents.odour: Bright, sweet orange peel. Thin, fast, oxidises.
constituents.note: Oxidation products are the sensitiser; keep citrus oils cold and dark.

constituents.name: alpha-Pinene
constituents.odour: Dry pine needle, turpentine, cold air.

constituents.name: beta-Pinene
constituents.odour: Drier and woodier than alpha, less sweet.

constituents.name: alpha-Phellandrene
constituents.odour: Peppery-citrus with a green bite. The pink-pepper sparkle.

constituents.name: beta-Caryophyllene
constituents.odour: Dry woody-peppery, the backbone of black pepper.

constituents.name: Linalool
constituents.odour: Fresh floral-woody with a lavender lift. The most-used molecule in perfumery.
constituents.note: Oxidises to sensitising hydroperoxides. A formula's total across all sources is what matters.

constituents.name: Nerol
constituents.odour: Fresher, greener, less sweet than geraniol.

constituents.name: Cedrol
constituents.odour: Soft dry cedar, faintly powdery. Very tenacious.

constituents.name: Patchoulol
constituents.odour: The patchouli itself: earthy, woody, faintly cocoa-sweet.

constituents.name: Norpatchoulenol
constituents.odour: Trace-level, disproportionately responsible for patchouli's character.
constituents.note: Present under 1% but a major driver of the odour.

constituents.name: Khusimol
constituents.odour: The main vetiver alcohol: dry, rooty, woody.

constituents.name: Sclareol
constituents.odour: Nearly odourless itself; the ambergris precursor.
constituents.note: Feedstock for Ambroxan.

constituents.name: 2-Phenylethanol
constituents.odour: Soft rose petal with a honey edge. Gentle, watery, never sharp.

constituents.name: alpha-Santalol
constituents.odour: The creamy, milky, sacred half of sandalwood.

constituents.name: beta-Santalol
constituents.odour: Drier, woodier, more radiant than alpha-santalol.

constituents.name: Linalyl acetate
constituents.note: Hydrolyses back to linalool in acidic or wet media.

constituents.name: Lavandulyl acetate
constituents.odour: Herbal-lavender, softer and rounder than linalyl acetate.

constituents.name: Benzyl benzoate
constituents.odour: Very faint sweet-balsamic. Mostly a fixative and a solvent.

constituents.name: Benzyl salicylate
constituents.odour: Soft balsamic-floral. Adds volume you cannot name.
constituents.note: Restricted; check the current amendment.

constituents.name: Methyl anthranilate
constituents.odour: Grape soda and orange blossom; a foxy, animal edge.

constituents.name: cis-3-Hexenyl acetate
constituents.odour: Cut grass and crushed stem — the smell of a broken leaf.

constituents.name: Coniferyl benzoate
constituents.odour: The bulk of Siam benzoin: sweet balsamic, faintly vanillic.
constituents.note: Largely non-volatile; a fixative mass more than an odour.

constituents.name: Eugenyl acetate
constituents.odour: Softer, sweeter, rounder clove than eugenol.

constituents.name: Methyl dihydrojasmonate
constituents.odour: Transparent jasmine-tea with a citrus-peel lift. Adds air, not smell.

constituents.name: Methyl jasmonate
constituents.odour: Rich, warm jasmine with a hay edge.

constituents.name: Fructone
constituents.odour: Green apple and pear drop. Sweet, juicy, synthetic in the best way.

constituents.name: Decanal (Aldehyde C-10)
constituents.odour: Waxy orange peel with a metallic sparkle.

constituents.name: 2-Methylundecanal (Aldehyde C-12 MNA)
constituents.odour: Ironed linen and soap. The Chanel aldehyde.

constituents.name: Citral (neral + geranial)
constituents.odour: Sharp lemon, green and slightly metallic.
constituents.note: Sensitiser; usually quenched with a terpene alcohol.

constituents.name: Cinnamaldehyde
constituents.note: Strong sensitiser. Tightly restricted.

constituents.name: Vanillin
constituents.odour: Vanilla: sweet, powdery, faintly phenolic and balsamic.
constituents.note: Discolours in alcohol and can yellow a formula.

constituents.name: Floralozone
constituents.odour: Ozone and cut water with a green-floral edge.

constituents.name: OTNE (Iso E Super)
constituents.odour: Dry transparent cedar-amber with a skin halo. Barely a smell; mostly volume.

constituents.name: gamma-Methylionone
constituents.odour: Violet, orris and old paper. Powdery-woody, suede-dry.

constituents.name: beta-Damascone
constituents.odour: Rose jam, plum and dried fruit. Enormous at trace level.

constituents.name: Rotundone
constituents.odour: Pure black pepper. Detectable in the parts per trillion.
constituents.note: Odour threshold is around 8 ng/L — among the lowest known.

constituents.name: DPMI (Cashmeran)
constituents.odour: Velvet musk-wood with a pine-spice top and a powdery warmth.

constituents.name: Civetone
constituents.odour: Warm, fatty, animal-musky. Sweet at dilution, fecal above it.

constituents.name: Camphor
constituents.odour: Sharp, cold, medicinal. Clears a room.

constituents.name: Eugenol
constituents.odour: Clove: hot, sweet, phenolic, faintly medicinal.
constituents.note: Restricted; also a strong quencher of other materials.

constituents.name: Isoeugenol
constituents.odour: Softer, sweeter, more floral clove than eugenol.
constituents.note: Tightly restricted.

constituents.name: Guaiacol
constituents.odour: Woodsmoke and creosote. Medicinal, tarry, unmistakable.

constituents.name: para-Cresyl methyl ether
constituents.odour: Narcotic ylang-floral with a rubbery, animal underside.

constituents.name: Phenylethyl methyl ether
constituents.odour: Green-floral with an anise lift. The kewra molecule.

constituents.name: Myristicin
constituents.odour: Warm, dry nutmeg with a faint narcotic edge.
constituents.note: Naturally restricted in nutmeg oil dosage.

constituents.name: Safrole
constituents.note: IFRA-prohibited as an isolate; trace levels in natural oils are limited.

constituents.name: Incensole acetate
constituents.odour: Cool, resinous, faintly balsamic. Frankincense's calm.

constituents.name: Indole
constituents.odour: Mothball and jasmine and something faintly fecal.

constituents.name: 3-Methylindole (Skatole)
constituents.odour: Fecal at strength; warm, floral, animal at trace.

constituents.name: Geosmin
constituents.odour: Wet earth after rain, beetroot, a cellar floor.
constituents.note: Detectable around 5 parts per trillion. Always dosed dilute.

constituents.name: Methyl atrarate
constituents.odour: Dry, inky, mossy. The compliant oakmoss stand-in.

constituents.name: 2-Furfurylthiol
constituents.odour: Roasted coffee. Sulfurous and burnt at strength.
constituents.note: Effective in the parts per billion.

constituents.name: Alkylpyrazines (as a class)
constituents.note: Recorded as a class; coffee CO2 carries dozens.

constituents.name: Coumarin
constituents.odour: New-mown hay and tonka, with an almond-powder sweetness.
constituents.note: Restricted.

constituents.name: gamma-Nonalactone
constituents.odour: Coconut and warm milk with a vanilla edge.

constituents.name: gamma-Undecalactone
constituents.odour: Ripe peach and apricot skin, creamy and waxy.

constituents.name: delta-Decalactone
constituents.odour: Butter, cream and soft peach. Dairy without the sourness.

constituents.name: omega-Pentadecalactone
constituents.odour: Warm, waxy, skin-musk. Almost no top, all presence.

constituents.name: (E)-Pentadec-11-enolide (Habanolide)
constituents.odour: Clean, airy laundry musk with a faint fruity-floral lift.

constituents.name: Ethylene brassylate
constituents.odour: Sweet, soft, slightly ambery musk. Cheap volume.

constituents.name: HHCB (Galaxolide)
constituents.odour: Clean laundry musk: sweet, powdery, cotton-soft.
constituents.note: Persistent in the environment; several markets are reducing it.

constituents.name: Ambroxide (Ambroxan)
constituents.odour: Dry mineral amber with a salt-skin transparency.

constituents.name: Norlimbanol
constituents.odour: Extremely dry woody-amber with a leather-animal edge. Brutal at overdose.

constituents.name: Ebanol
constituents.odour: Creamy sandalwood with a nutty, buttery softness.

constituents.name: Bacdanol
constituents.odour: Creamy-milky sandalwood with a rosy warmth.

constituents.name: Acetyl cedrene
constituents.odour: Dry woody-ambery with a smoky, rooty underside.

constituents.name: Dihydromyrcenol
constituents.odour: Clean, soapy, citrus-lavender with a metallic edge. The 1990s.

constituents.name: Ethyl maltol
constituents.note: Overwhelms a formula above a fraction of a percent.

constituents.name: Labdane diterpenes (labdanolic acid and relatives)
constituents.odour: The dark, sweet, leathery mass of labdanum. Barely volatile.
constituents.note: Recorded as a class. Most of a labdanum resinoid's weight.

constituents.name: Siaresinolic acid and resin acids
constituents.odour: Odourless resin mass. Fixative weight, not smell.
constituents.note: Non-volatile.

constituents.name: Furanoeudesma-1,3-diene
constituents.odour: The bitter, medicinal heart of myrrh.

constituents.name: Isophytol
constituents.odour: Practically odourless; a natural fixative and diluent.

constituents.name: Lipids, waxes and other non-volatiles
constituents.odour: No odour of their own. Carrier mass in a CO2 total extract.
constituents.note: Non-volatile.

constituents.name: Caffeine
constituents.odour: Odourless. Rides along in a coffee extract.
constituents.note: Non-volatile.

constituents.name: Isopropyl myristate
constituents.odour: Odourless, very slightly oily on skin.

constituents.name: Ethanol
constituents.odour: Sharp and volatile; gone in seconds.
